agent.name: Silver-Milk Team Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: Dated technology-landscape intelligence: eight fixed landscape dimensions (capability, use cases, trackers, ecosystem, standards, price/performance, coverage, alternatives) each with a basis, broad signals separated from the few that matter to this organization, execution gates kept apart from landscape signals, a gating-condition x movement table that sets the monitoring stance, owned triggers mapped to actions, and a dated stale/hype flag (never the adoption decision, never a vendor selection)

analytical_question: Where do text-to-image diffusion models and adjacent editing approaches sit in the landscape for disposable internal campaign concepts, and what external evidence should the retailer monitor during its six-week review?
general_et_finding:
AS OF: 2026-11-13
UNIT: Text-to-image diffusion models, with latent diffusion as the historical reference architecture.
L1 TECHNICAL CAPABILITY: Developing — independent Stable Diffusion chair-design experiments show useful bounded concept visualization with designer interpretation and iteration (Designing with Words, 2024-10). BASIS: E1.
L2 USE-CASE EVIDENCE: Use cases emerging — the vendor documents Stable Diffusion 3 Large in a live HubSpot workflow. Independent evidence of routine production across organizations is missing (Stability AI, 2025-09). BASIS: E2.
L3 TRACKER PLACEMENT: Not covered by Thoughtworks Technology Radar Volume 35 — no category placement or movement assigned (Thoughtworks, 2026-11). BASIS: E3.
L4 VENDOR/ECOSYSTEM STRUCTURE: Consolidating — hosted platforms bundle models from competing suppliers. The evidence establishes bundling, with market shares unverified (Adobe, 2026-09; Stability AI, 2025-09). BASIS: E2, E4.
L5 STANDARDS & REGULATION: Emerging — U.S. Copyright Office guidance on human authorship applies to generative AI broadly. The register establishes no diffusion-specific binding rule (U.S. Copyright Office, 2025-01). BASIS: E5.
L6 PRICE/PERFORMANCE: Mixed — published image rates vary by model, resolution and reference input. The observed menu supports a mixed pricing picture. A quality-matched 12-month category trend remains unverified (Black Forest Labs, 2026-10). BASIS: E6.
L7 COVERAGE TONE: Mixed — coverage includes expanded creative capabilities and contested training-data practices (VentureBeat, 2026-07; PetaPixel, 2026-08). BASIS: E7, E8.
L8 ALTERNATIVES & COMPLEMENTS: INCUMBENT: manually assembled boards and composites. COMPETING: reference-conditioned image editing and multimodal image generation. COMPLEMENTS: curated reference assets, conventional editing tools and human review.
POSITION: Diffusion models have demonstrated bounded creative utility and some documented production use. application_finding:
APPLICATION SIGNALS: L1 matters because plausible scenes can still misrepresent product shape, finish or color. L2 matters because a visually appealing output provides little evidence about repeatable board preparation. L6 matters because generation charges, iteration, correction and review all contribute to cost per usable board.
APPLICATION-SPECIFIC EVIDENCE: Thin — independent product-concept and reference-fidelity studies offer nearby evidence. An independent comparison on disposable homeware campaign boards was unavailable.
STRONGEST ALTERNATIVE: Manually assembled boards and composites — existing product imagery anchors product attributes while allowing deliberate changes to layout and creative direction.
organization_specific_finding:
UNIT OF ANALYSIS: The owner and two marketers at the hypothetical U.S. online homeware retailer.
GATING CONDITION: A hosted option must have credible comparative evidence that it can preserve catalog-reference details in disposable internal boards at a workable all-in effort relative to manual or freelance preparation.
CONDITION STATUS: Partly met — hosted workflows exist and an independent study shows a reference-conditioning advantage on adjacent tasks. Comparable homeware board fidelity and labor are unverified. BASIS: E9, E10.
MOVEMENT: None — the 2026 study compares workflows within one task. It supplies no observed improvement over time toward the joint fidelity and effort condition. BASIS: E9, E10.
STANCE: Scheduled watch
EXECUTION GATES: Exact plan terms and permitted business uploads, catalog input rights, retention and security review, and procurement clearance — owner not stated. Management authorization for use — owner. AI sponsorship, coordination, review responsibility and protected hours — owner not stated.
RELEVANT SIGNALS: L1 — adjacent independent evidence favors reference conditioning for preserving visual detail, relevant to catalog accuracy. L4 — hosted interfaces expose multiple workflows, relevant because the retailer has no ML team. L6 — variable metering matters because the two marketers' comparative all-in hours are unknown.
POPULAR BUT NOT DECISIVE HERE: The FLUX 3 multimodal launch offers little evidence about internal board preparation or review effort.
MOST CONSEQUENTIAL DEVELOPMENT: L1 — the independent July 2026 comparison found stronger visual consistency from reference conditioning than from a prompt-led workflow on architectural renderings. This could change whether reference editing is included in a prepared comparison.
ECOSYSTEM DEPENDENCY: The hosted provider's continued support for the specific reference-conditioning controls.
OPTIONS DOCUMENTED: Adobe Firefly Text to Image offers adjustable composition-reference strength (vendor-claim, E10). Adobe Firefly Boards lists GPT Image 1.5 as a partner generation option (vendor-claim, E4). NO SELECTION.

evidence.claim: E1: An independent study used Stable Diffusion in a series of industrial design experiments to visualize chair concepts.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: independent. LOAD-BEARING. Bounded action research. It establishes concept visualization in a real design task and leaves routine reliability and labor savings unmeasured.

evidence.claim: E2: Stability AI reports that HubSpot integrated Stable Diffusion 3 Large through Amazon Bedrock into a customer-facing content workflow.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: vendor-claim. UNDERLYING: HubSpot deployment profiled by AWS and Stability AI, counted once. LOAD-BEARING. The deployment is identifiable. Generation volume does not establish accepted assets or comparative labor.

evidence.claim: E3: Thoughtworks Technology Radar Volume 35 provides no placement for text-to-image diffusion models.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: industry-analyst. LOAD-BEARING. The edition was checked for category coverage. Its scope does not support a placement or movement inference for this unit.

evidence.claim: E4: Adobe documents partner image models in Firefly Boards, including FLUX Kontext MAX and GPT Image 1.5.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: vendor-claim. LOAD-BEARING. Evidence of distribution bundling. A shared interface establishes neither shared architecture nor equivalent capabilities.

evidence.claim: E5: The U.S. Copyright Office published its report on AI output copyrightability and the role of human authorship.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: standards-regulatory. LOAD-BEARING. Issuer summary of a policy report interpreting existing law. It establishes no new binding diffusion-specific rule.

evidence.claim: E6: Black Forest Labs publishes model- and resolution-dependent image-generation rates, with reference-input charges for some models and a separate time-limited FLUX 3 Image launch offer.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: vendor-claim. LOAD-BEARING. The offer is explicitly dated 1–8 October 2026. The live menu supplies pricing context and no quality-matched history or historical November 13 snapshot.

evidence.claim: E7: VentureBeat covered FLUX 3 as a multimodal product expansion and reported limited access at launch.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: industry-analyst. UNDERLYING: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 launch. LOAD-BEARING for coverage tone only. Product capabilities reported from the launch do not validate workflow outcomes.

evidence.claim: E8: PetaPixel covered EVOX's allegations about Midjourney's use of copyrighted vehicle photographs.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: industry-analyst. UNDERLYING: EVOX complaint filed July 30, 2026. LOAD-BEARING for coverage tone only. The allegations are a coverage signal.

evidence.claim: E9: A peer-reviewed FLUX.1 study found that image conditioning preserved details more consistently than prompt-led generation in its architectural rendering comparison.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: independent. LOAD-BEARING for the application and organizational gate. Adjacent image-to-image workflow comparison. It establishes neither homeware fidelity nor a change over time.

evidence.claim: E10: Adobe documents a Firefly Text to Image workflow where users add a composition reference and adjust adherence strength.
evidence.notes: STATUS: inspected-this-run. SOURCE CLASS: vendor-claim. LOAD-BEARING for option availability. The documentation describes composition controls and supplies no independent test of exact product details or net review time.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: COMPETING READING: Background scan is defensible if the owner treats comparable evidence on both fidelity and all-in effort as the minimum before giving any weight to external progress. Scheduled watch credits verified option availability and adjacent independent evidence as partial progress toward the condition.
CHASM EVIDENCE FOR: E2 (2025-09-03) identifies a live Stable Diffusion 3 Large deployment inside HubSpot's content workflow. Its vendor provenance limits the inference to a documented deployment.
CHASM EVIDENCE AGAINST: E1 (2024-10) documents controlled, designer-led concept work. Its results stop short of showing repeated production use or routine review across teams.

DISTINGUISHING EVIDENCE: Dated reports from independent issuers documenting repeated production use of identified text-to-image diffusion models across several organizations, with workflow and review outcomes.

STALE/HYPE FLAG: E6's 50% FLUX 3 Image launch offer ran 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-08. The expired price would understate current list-price estimates and omits labor. CONTROL: Excluded the promotional rate from stance and cost assumptions. REFRESH BY: 2026-12-23.

The case references a source ledger checked on 2026-11-13. The ledger was unavailable, so its contents and claimed verification were not used. The run uses retrieved sources that establish facts dated on or before the assessment cutoff, with the live pricing page explicitly identified as a later observation. No retailer trial, acceptance rate or savings figure is available.
confidence_and_uncertainty: CONFIDENCE: Moderate — broad landscape confidence is moderate for bounded utility, documented production and hosted bundling, and low for the category-wide price/performance trend. Local relevance confidence is moderate for prioritizing reference fidelity and low for predicting retailer outcomes. Thoughtworks Volume 35 was retrieved. No applicable Gartner, IEEE, Forrester or IDC category placement was verified, and independent evidence across several comparable production workflows was unavailable.
value_opportunity_implication: Hosted generation could broaden the range of visual directions available for owner review. The economic unit is an internally usable board, including marketer time spent sourcing references, generating variations, correcting details and reviewing the result against the manual or freelance baseline.
risk_governance_implication: The case limits exposure through disposable internal boards, owner review and independently checked final product photographs. Product-detail distortion, accidental downstream reuse and displacement of marketer time remain the primary workflow risks.
recommendation_management_implication: STANCE: Scheduled watch — WATCH FIRST: independent comparisons that measure fidelity to supplied product references and total preparation and review effort. STRONGEST ALTERNATIVE: manually assembled boards and composites using existing product photography and freelance support as needed. REFRESH: quarterly for the landscape, with a checkpoint by 2026-12-23 for this six-week review and a full source refresh at least annually.
change_monitoring_triggers: TRIGGER 1 [L2] USE-CASE: A dated independent report documents a comparable small retailer's recurring internal board workflow and an improvement in reference fidelity at comparable all-in effort against its manual baseline, with threshold pending owner approval — SOURCE: peer-reviewed design study or independent case audit — OWNER: marketing lead (proposed) — CADENCE: quarterly and at the six-week checkpoint → Active watch

TRIGGER 2 [L1] REVERSAL: A dated independent product-reference evaluation finds that the comparable hosted workflows materially alter catalog product attributes, with threshold pending owner approval — SOURCE: independent evaluation with disclosed reference set and error analysis — OWNER: owner (proposed) — CADENCE: quarterly and at the six-week checkpoint → Background scan
abstention_or_more_information_needed: MORE INFO → Original source ledger, manual and freelance preparation and review hours, and the owner's fidelity and effort criteria: these would allow source reconciliation and show whether external comparisons address the retailer's baseline.
